posts.title_en: Crumb sugar rune optimizer open for 48 hours (and the 'secret sauce')
posts.summary_en: Arsen, a foreign top player, opens tools on https://crumb.gg/: a sugar rune optimizer (48 hours only), a plate enhancement simulator and a damage formula visualizer. Calculations run on his server for logged-in users, and the site will stay ad-free. The post makes no cookie level cap claim. Screenshots: (1) the rune optimizer spends 1M Rune Crystals for +49.22% in total, most of it on the Milk cookie (+28.01% for 357k). (2) A worked attack chain for Bright Seeker (Lv.100, 10-star) splits ATK into sugar runes, Gnome Lab, Guild Lab, Stellar Link and Resolve. It ranks damage per +1% of each stat; the guild lab multiplier works out to about ×1.30. (3) The cheapest +15 → +20 plating path averages 3,194 Chocosteel and 624 Syrup Metal, counting 1 Syrup Metal = 50 Chocosteel.

Implied multipliers: runes ×1.20, Gnome ×6.0, Stellar ×5.0, Resolve +100,000 ATK.

Damage per +1 step: fixed ATK +1,000 +3.61%; ATK buff +1% +0.81%; sugar rune ATK amp +1% +0.77%; guild lab ATK amp +1% +0.71%; skill haste +1 +0.68%; skill amp +1% +0.45%; element dmg +1% +0.43%; crit dmg +1% +0.38%; crit rate +1% +0.34%; boss dmg +1% +0.33%; Stellar ATK amp +1% +0.18%; Gnome lab ATK amp +1% +0.15%; Resolve ATK +1,000 +0.08%.
